howToApply: Visit the official CPRI website at https://cpri.res.in/ and navigate to the recruitment/career section.
Before registering, ensure you have a valid self e-mail ID and mobile number, scanned passport size color photograph, scanned signature, and scanned copies of all required certificates in PDF format.
Register and fill in the online application form with accurate and complete information.

Upload scanned photograph, signature, and all required documents (SSLC/SSC/Matriculation Certificate, Degree/Diploma/ITI Trade Certificate & Marks card, experience certificate, BCC certificate from NIELIT, Caste/Category Certificate, NOC, Ex-servicemen ID card & Discharge Certificate, as applicable).
Pay the prescribed application fee online (inclusive of GST). SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-servicemen/Women are exempted from payment of fees.
Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate online application forms for each post with separate fees.
Take a printout of the submitted application form and retain it for future reference.
Online Registration Opening: 19.09.2026 (10:00 AM); Closing: 12.10.2026 (05:00 PM).

dates.event: Online Application Form Availability Start Date

howToApply: Visit BCPL official website www.bcplonline.co.in and navigate to the Careers section.
Read the detailed advertisement carefully and ensure you meet all eligibility criteria before applying.
Register online and fill in the Application Form with accurate details including personal, educational, and experience information.

Upload required documents: passport size photograph, signature, proof of age, caste/category certificate, disability certificate (if applicable), mark sheets, qualification certificates, and experience certificates in digital format (.jpg/.pdf, max 200 KB).
Pay the application fee online through the payment gateway available on the website (Rs. 200/- for General/EWS/OBC(NCL); SC/ST/PwBD candidates are exempted).
Submit the online Application Form and download the system-generated Pay-in slip and Registration Slip with unique registration number.
Keep a copy of the Application Form with unique application sequence number for future reference.
Candidates are NOT required to send hard copy of the Application Form to BCPL.
If called for further Selection Process, bring the downloaded Application Form along with all original documents and one self-attested photocopy set.
